campaign.title: Unbalanced M2 prescribed-centre truncated-divisor falsification and viability gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use primary divisor-wave, reciprocal-sum, Voronoi, or spectral sources only after matching the literal prescribed centre, truncated character divisor orientation, profiles, endpoints, and pointwise norm. Structural analogy has no proof status.

frozen_target.question: Does the exact smooth unbalanced M2 prescribed-centre truncated divisor wave satisfy O(X^(1/4+epsilon)), admit a target-safe strict subrange or quantified actual-sign saving, fail by a rigorous literal coherent countermodel, or reduce to a smaller signed survivor after the proposed falsification controls?
frozen_target.reference_formula: R_(D,L)(X)=sum_s sum_(r|s,r odd) chi_4(r) W(X/(rD)) Q_L(r(X-s)/(4X)), with Q_L(y)=int q_L(h)h^(-1)e(hy)dh, r asymp X/D, |s-X| rapidly restricted to D/L, absolute capacity (D/L)X^epsilon, and target X^(1/4+epsilon). Equivalently R=sum_(r odd)chi_4(r)W(X/(rD))sum_k q_L(4Xk/r^2)k^(-1)e(Xk/r), modulo the accepted flat-smooth normalization and target-safe stationary remainder.
quantities: X large real; D=X^delta and L=X^ell in the strict residual unbalanced region
K=XL/D^2, M=LK, F=XL/D, Delta=D/L, missing factor H_D/L=D/(LX^(1/4))
literal nonnegative q_L and smooth W profiles with inherited Vaaler height taper
chi_4 remains on the odd complementary divisor r; the truncated coefficient is not r_2/4
exact centre s=X is divisor-bounded and cannot alone falsify the target
a positive or coherent subset is not a lower bound without controlling every complementary signed term
Round 117 exposes an analogous prescribed-centre product wave but supplies no automatic exponent transfer
sharp, starred, hard, and arithmetic-owner endpoints lie outside a flat-smooth claim unless their exact kernels are retained

completion_criteria: Rederive the wave in both divisor-product and reciprocal-row orientations, including scale, character, real centre, profiles, and target normalization.
Audit exact centre, near centre, primes in both odd classes, squares, fourth powers, divisor-rich products, short coherent runs, and profile edges.
Any countermodel must give a lower bound for the complete literal outside-absolute wave and control the entire signed complement.
Any upper bound must name the cancellation mechanism and price the sparse selector, character, profiles, endpoints, and every norm or transform factor.
Prove the full X^(1/4) target, a nonempty target-safe strict region, a quantified actual-sign saving, a rigorous literal countermodel, or a scoped no-go with the smallest signed survivor.
Show why the argument does not also prove the false unsigned or arbitrary-coefficient analogue.
Audit every external theorem against the prescribed real centre, truncated divisor orientation, parameter range, coefficient norm, and endpoint hypotheses.
Do not claim hard TOP, BAL, all UNBAL boundaries, M9-M2, M9, or an exponent change from a proper flat smooth subpacket.

tasks.target: Independently stress-test the exact prescribed-centre truncated divisor wave, derive all arithmetic and coherent-run controls, and prove the target, a strict subrange or saving, a literal countermodel, or the first exact obstruction.
excluded_context: all Round-107 and Round-117 reports and reviews
the Round-118 derivation packet and conductor candidate
required_output: Exact central, near-central, arithmetic, coherent-run, complement, and capacity controls.
A complete estimate/countermodel or a precisely scoped no-go with the smallest survivor.
A promote, retain, revise, reject, or no-change recommendation.

tasks.target: Attack the literal fixed-centre wave before absolute values. Test the reciprocal-selector coherent-run scenario, seek a target-safe subrange or quantitative signed saving, and retain every actual profile and endpoint in any claimed estimate or countermodel.
required_output: The strongest proved target, strict region, saving, literal countermodel, or exact signed survivor.
Every selector, character, curvature, transform, Cauchy, divisor, profile, and endpoint factor charged.

tasks.target: Hostilely audit every proposed upper bound and countermodel for complement cancellation, transform self-return, false positivity, endpoint loss, and exact primary-source theorem fit; determine whether the pointwise wave strategy remains viable.
required_output: A pass/fail table for normalization, arithmetic controls, complement, capacity, endpoints, sources, and scope.
A rigorous named no-go, verified countermodel, or the exact theorem still required.

review_seams.requirement: The exact profile, Vaaler taper, character orientation, real centre, flat-smooth scope, and physical normalization are retained.
Exact centre, ties, primes, squares, fourth powers, divisor-rich products, and near-centre products are tested without completing the divisor sum.
A claimed lower bound controls the complete signed complement and the literal complex kernel, not merely a positive subset.
Sparse reciprocal selection, run length, product residual, congruence, and profile support are all charged.
Every transform, curvature, Cauchy, divisor, and endpoint factor is compared with D/L and X^(1/4).
Any saving or countermodel uses the fixed literal coefficient and does not prove a false arbitrary-sign analogue.
Every source theorem matches the pointwise real centre, truncated character divisor orientation, parameter range, norm, and endpoints.
A flat smooth result is not promoted as hard TOP, BAL, complete UNBAL, M9-M2, M9, or a global exponent without the full owner assembly.
